title: Desktop: text only — no attachments
body: Owner, 2026-10-01: the desktop is text only too, like the phone (#10093, `ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED`). Hide the attach (paperclip) control and every way to attach on the desktop: picker, paste of images, drag and drop of files/images; drafts accept text only; a restored draft with images sends its words only. Use the same switch as the phone (or a desktop switch next to it) so both turn back on together; keep the image pipeline code. Update the release gate: `image-to-coder` becomes a check that the desktop has no attach control and drops a pasted/dropped image. Update docs/INVARIANTS/glossary notes from #10093 ("phone attachments off") to say attachments are off everywhere. Owner also put the desktop in **development mode**: verify with debug builds and the gate's `--bin-dir` mode; do not package or install a release app.
